scenes.setting: The reception, on a knife's edge: 'my child told me — he knows a lot'; Leonard keeps Megose talking while Klein slips away

scenes.setting: The blue-lit corridor: Dunn ascends with the bone-silver box of Saint Selena's ashes and sends Klein for the strongest Sealed Artifact
